skill.name: peer-review
skill.description: Evaluate scientific manuscripts, grant proposals, and slide decks for methodology, statistics, reproducibility, ethics, figures, and reporting standards.
skill.summary: Structured scientific peer review guidance for rigorous, constructive research evaluation.
skill.author: davila7

security_audit.summary: Most static findings are false positives from scientific review terminology or Markdown backticks. Two Bash examples are confirmed external command risks because the skill instructs agents to run local Python utilities for schematic generation and PDF conversion.

remediation.issue: The skill instructs agents to run local Python scripts from Bash.
remediation.suggestion: Require explicit user confirmation before running these commands, and document that file paths and diagram text must be sanitized.

remediation.issue: The presentation workflow processes user-supplied PDF files with a local converter.
remediation.suggestion: Add guidance to run conversion only in a trusted workspace and to avoid processing untrusted files without user approval.

content.value_statement: Scientific reviews can miss methodological, statistical, and reporting problems. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through structured peer review.
actual_capabilities: Guides section-by-section review of abstracts, introductions, methods, results, discussions, and references.
Checks statistical rigor, sample size justification, missing data handling, effect sizes, and multiple testing correction.
Assesses reproducibility through data availability, code sharing, protocol detail, and reporting guideline compliance.
Reviews figures, tables, image integrity, slide decks, and accessibility of scientific visuals.
Structures review reports with summaries, major comments, minor comments, author questions, and final recommendations.
Provides reference material for common issues and standards such as CONSORT, STROBE, PRISMA, ARRIVE, MIAME, and MINSEQE.
limitations: It does not independently verify raw data or rerun analyses unless the user supplies data and tools.
It cannot replace editor judgment, journal policy, or specialist domain review.
Presentation conversion guidance depends on local Python scripts being available.
Review quality depends on the completeness of the supplied manuscript, figures, slides, and venue criteria.

use_cases.title: Journal Manuscript Review
use_cases.description: Prepare a balanced review that separates major validity concerns from smaller clarity and presentation issues.

use_cases.title: Grant Proposal Evaluation
use_cases.description: Assess research design, feasibility, statistical planning, ethical safeguards, and reproducibility commitments.

use_cases.title: Internal Lab Review
use_cases.description: Review drafts before submission and identify gaps in methods, controls, figures, and reporting standards.

prompt_templates.title: Quick Manuscript Triage
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this manuscript draft for overall soundness. Summarize the research question, main strengths, major concerns, and likely revision level.

prompt_templates.title: Section-by-Section Review
prompt_templates.prompt: Evaluate each manuscript section. Separate comments for abstract, introduction, methods, results, discussion, figures, references, and writing clarity.

prompt_templates.title: Methods and Statistics Audit
prompt_templates.prompt: Assess the methods and statistical analysis. Check controls, replication, assumptions, missing data, power, effect sizes, and multiple testing correction.

prompt_templates.title: Full Review with Standards
prompt_templates.prompt: Produce a full peer review using the relevant reporting guideline. Include summary, major comments, minor comments, author questions, and recommendation.

output_examples.input: Review a biomedical manuscript for statistical rigor and reporting completeness.
output: Summary: The study asks an important question, but reporting gaps limit confidence in the conclusions.
Major comment: The methods do not justify sample size or describe randomization.
Minor comment: Figure legends should define error bars and sample sizes.

output_examples.input: Assess whether a systematic review follows PRISMA expectations.
output: The review describes eligibility criteria and databases, but the search strategy lacks reproducible detail.
The study selection process needs a flow diagram and reasons for exclusion.
Publication bias and heterogeneity should be assessed before interpreting pooled effects.

output_examples.input: Review a scientific slide deck before a conference presentation.
output: The talk has a clear narrative, but several slides contain dense text.
Slide-specific issues include small axis labels, inconsistent figure captions, and weak color contrast.
Recommended revision level: minor content edits and moderate visual cleanup.

best_practices: Provide the manuscript, figures, supplement, target venue, and review criteria together.
State the discipline, study type, and expected reporting guideline before review.
Ask for major and minor comments with evidence and actionable revision suggestions.
anti_patterns: Do not request an accept or reject decision without supplying methods, results, and venue context.
Do not use the skill to invent criticisms that are not supported by the manuscript.
Do not run external conversion commands on untrusted files without explicit user approval.

faq.question: Can this skill review grant proposals?
faq.answer: Yes. It can assess design, feasibility, rigor, ethics, reproducibility, and clarity for research applications.

faq.question: Does it support reporting guidelines?
faq.answer: Yes. It references major standards such as CONSORT, STROBE, PRISMA, ARRIVE, MIAME, and MINSEQE.

faq.question: Can it check statistics?
faq.answer: It can identify likely issues in test choice, power, missing data, effect sizes, and multiple comparisons.

faq.question: Does it verify raw data?
faq.answer: No. It can review reported methods and results, but independent verification requires supplied data and analysis tools.

faq.question: Can it review slide decks?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes guidance for image-based slide review, visual clarity, accessibility, timing, and slide-specific feedback.

faq.question: Is it only for biomedical research?
faq.answer: No. It is most detailed for scientific manuscripts, but the workflow can support many research disciplines.
